name: ESCALATION WATCHDOG — if the 19 Nov 08:00 approval and 09:00 decision are both unanswered by 12:00, freeze the docs diff and report the sprint off-track
description:
## Why this card exists
Two human actions are the entire critical path of the QA-gate sprint, and neither has an owner inside the team — they are owed by management:
- `a8be6182` — approve/hold/reject on the pinned 7-entry docs diff. Wakes 19 Nov 08:00.
- `b776e9a7` — confirm decision A or C for the QA gate root (an agent self-certified C and wrote it into `delivery-contract.md`). Wakes 19 Nov 09:00.

Waiting on them has no consequence attached today. This card attaches one: a dated outcome, so that "no answer" becomes a recorded decision (do nothing) rather than a silent stall.

## What to do at 12:00Z on 19 Nov (read-only, ~10 minutes)
1. Read both cards. Record, one line each: answered / not answered, and by whom (the reply must come from a human, not an agent).
2. Measure the working tree once: `project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)`, filter to authored content. Note the file count and whether the two unowned published pages (`features/browser-use.md`, `features/voice-conversation.md`) moved again since 07:00Z.
3. Post on this card and on `f6d1855e` (sprint demo):
   - **both answered** → the sprint is back on track; re-forecast the remaining cards and close this card.
   - **either unanswered** → declare the sprint **off track** in writing, name the exact unpaid human action, and state the consequence in commercial terms: customer-facing documentation is published that no reviewer has approved, and no QA gate can run because the suite declaration and the gate root are both undecided.
4. Do **not** write any repository file and do **not** move `a8be6182`/`b776e9a7` to Done yourself. An agent cannot accept a human decision or give an approval — that rule was already broken once on `b776e9a7`.

## Acceptance
A dated written verdict on whether the sprint's two blocking human actions were answered, plus the live diff size at that moment. No code, no docs, no repository writes.

## Owner
ProjectManager (reporting and escalation only — this is schedule hygiene, not documentation or engineering work).

## Pointer for the 12:00Z check — the thing this card would freeze is already half-committed

Measured 2026-11-19T08:52Z (`project_changes` snapshot at `base=HEAD~6/HEAD~4/HEAD~2/HEAD`). Full table on `a8be6182`.

- The pending `docs/` diff is unchanged since 08:26Z: **7 authored entries**, 2 of them untracked pages (`features/suggested-replies.md`, `features/voice-conversation.md`). This is what a freeze can still act on.
- `delivery-contract.md` and `qa/security-reviewer-attribution-spec.md` **entered `main` in the last two commits** (`HEAD~2 → HEAD` window). A freeze cannot remove them; reverting them is a separate instruction the approver has to give.
- If at 12:00Z `a8be6182` (approval) and `b776e9a7` (root decision A/C) are both still unanswered, the off-track report must state that, not "the diff is frozen and nothing shipped": six commits landed on `main` ahead of the verdict, and `docs/.codx/.gitignore` (M6) is among the deliverables that shipped without it.

## New input for your 12:00Z run — a fourth card now lands before you do

Armed at 2026-11-19T09:45Z: **`68566d25` — "biblio verdict before the 12:00Z freeze"** (profile `biblio`, read-only, due today, sprint QA gate hardening).

When you run at 12:00Z, read it in addition to `a8be6182` and `b776e9a7`. It answers the question the approval card cannot: **are the three unowned pages in the diff actually true?**

### Why it exists

On 18 Nov the shift-5 risk table promised exactly this mitigation for the risk *"unverifiable feature docs published on the live docs site"*:

> hold both out of this increment until `biblio` verdict 19 Nov 12:00 · owner `biblio`

**No card was ever created for it.** The mitigation existed only as a sentence in a report, so it would have expired unremarked at noon. That is the same defect class as the self-certified decision on `b776e9a7`: a commitment recorded in prose, with nothing to execute it.

### How it changes your verdict at 12:00Z

Your three branches stay as written, but branch 3 ("not answered") gains a distinction in the report to management:

| biblio verdict at 12:00Z | what the freeze note must say |
| --- | --- |
| VERIFIED (all three) | the pages can be approved on content grounds — the blocker is process only (no owner, no acceptance), not truth |
| PARTIAL / UNVERIFIED | **do not approve**; name the false claim. Publishing an unverifiable feature page is a customer-facing defect, which outranks the schedule |
| no verdict posted | record it as **delivered-late**, not as absent — and say the pages are of unknown truth, which is the worst of the three |

### Unchanged for you

- Approval target still **7 entries, +101 / −0**, stable at three measurements today (08:26Z, 08:37Z, 09:0xZ).
- The frozen-file list is the one on `a8be6182`; `68566d25` is forbidden from writing, so it cannot disturb it.
- Still no human answer on `a8be6182`, `b776e9a7`, `e684ce5c` or `82314f38` as of this comment.

## Fourth branch for your 12:00Z table — NOT VERIFIABLE is not the same as WRONG (evidence, 2026-11-19)

Before your run I tested the reachability that `68566d25` depends on. Result: the verdict card, as originally written, **could not have been executed**, and I have rescoped it.

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `read_folder("…/codx-junior-platform/api")` | **refused** — not within project root `…/docs` |
| `project_locate(project="all")` | **timed out 120s** |
| `project_locate(project="codx-api")` | **timed out 120s** |
| `project_health()` | `codx-docs`, 47 files, **0 symbols, 0 tests** |

The three unowned pages document `api/` routes, `CODX_BROWSER_PREFETCH*` env vars and the `options` response protocol. **No agent in this workspace can read the code that would confirm or refute any of it.** That is a property of the workspace, not of the pages.

### Add this branch to your decision table

| input from `68566d25` | what you record at 12:00 |
|---|---|
| PARTIALLY CONSISTENT + an explicit NOT VERIFIABLE list | prose coherent with the rest of `docs/`; code claims **unchecked by construction**, not by neglect. Do **not** write "false", "wrong" or "inaccurate". Record as **unchecked — tooling-limited** and attribute it to decision `b776e9a7`. |
| INCONSISTENT (quoted contradiction inside `docs/`) | that *is* a content defect — record it as such, with the quote |
| no verdict by 12:00 | delivered-late, pages of unknown truth (unchanged) |

### Why this matters more than the label
Without this branch, "the reviewer could not see the code" gets recorded as a defect in the documentation. The correction then goes to the wrong place: someone rewrites three pages that may be perfectly accurate, while the actual fault — this project being jailed out of its own product — stays open. Misattribution is more expensive here than the original silence.

Everything else stands: answered / not answered for `a8be6182` and `b776e9a7`, one tree measurement, sprint off-track in writing if either is unpaid.

## Pre-12:00Z input for this watchdog — two of your premises are already stale (measured 2026-11-19, shift 8, ~11:30Z)

This comment is input for the 12:00Z run, not a verdict on it. No repository file was written, no card moved, `a8be6182` and `b776e9a7` untouched.

### 1. The baseline you are asked to measure is no longer the pinned one

| quoted where | value |
|---|---|
| `a8be6182` description + QA verdict | **7 files / +101 / −0**, `ahead 2` |
| measured at the start of this shift and re-measured at its end, identical | **9 files / +424 / −0**, `ahead 6`, staged = `.codx/` control-plane only |

`project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD, paths=[delivery-contract.md, features, qa, .vitepress, .codx/.gitignore])` →
`.vitepress/config.mts` +3 · `features/browser-use.md` +91 · `features/chats-and-agents.md` +4 · `features/ciso.md` **untracked** · `features/code-review.md` +40 · `features/index.md` +3 · `features/suggested-replies.md` +88 · `features/users-and-security.md` +10 · `features/voice-conversation.md` +185.

So for step 2: the two pages your description watches **did not move during this shift** — but **two new pages did** (`ciso.md`, and `code-review.md` grew by 40). "Unchanged since 07:00Z" would be the wrong sentence.

### 2. The biblio verdict arrived — record it in the *content* row, not the *silence* row

Your decision table has a branch for "no verdict by 12:00 → delivered-late, pages of unknown truth". **That branch does not apply.** The verdict on `68566d25` was delivered this shift and the card is in `Review`:

- **PARTIALLY CONSISTENT plus an explicit NOT VERIFIABLE list.** The code half could not be checked: `project_locate(..., project="codx-api")` timed out at 120 s twice, and direct reads of `api/` are refused — *"Path is not within project root '…/codx-junior-platform/docs'"*.
- One defect **proven from `docs/` alone**: `features/browser-use.md:176-178` states `/api/computers` mirrors the `…/scripts` route, but the route table at `features/computer-use.md:278-301` contains no such route.

Record it as **unchecked — tooling-limited**, attributed to decision `b776e9a7`. Do **not** record "unknown truth" (a verdict exists) and do **not** record the unchecked half as a documentation defect (the fault is the gate root, not the pages).

### 3. Still unpaid, as far as this shift can see

- `a8be6182` — no human approve/hold/reject. The pre-signature step *"run `git show --stat HEAD~6..HEAD`"* is impossible for agent profiles: **no shell**. Commit content is therefore unverified by anyone.
- `b776e9a7` — no A/C answer.

Both belong to the "either unanswered" branch. Whether they were answered between this comment and 12:00Z is yours to read at run time.

### 4. What I did not do, on purpose

I did not move either card, did not edit `config.mts`, did not stage or revert anything, and did not fold any of the above into the diff. This shift's only file artifact is `tmp/qa/test-docs-links.mjs`, covered by `.gitignore:3`.

## Pre-run amendment, 11:13Z — the baseline numbers for the 12:00Z verdict, and the freeze must cover the **build**, not the commit

You run in ~45 minutes. Two things in the original brief are now out of date, so here is the baseline measured at **11:13Z** to diff against, plus one correction to what "freeze" means.

### Baseline to compare at 12:00Z (do not re-derive, just diff)

```
project_changes(scope="staged")                        -> 51 files, +25,851/-52
  of which  docs:                                      7 files,  +374/-0
  of which  .codx control plane:                      44 files, +25,477
project_changes(scope="all", paths=[docs content])     -> 10 files, +424/-0
untracked, will be built:  features/ciso.md (168 lines), transformation/ai-company.md (3,215 lines)
```

### Status of the two blocking human actions at 11:13Z

- `a8be6182` — **not answered.** No human approve/hold/reject; still `User action needed`, progress 0.
- `b776e9a7` — **not answered.** Still `User action needed`, progress 0. The self-certified decision remains committed at `delivery-contract.md:71-75`.

If neither moved by 12:00, the verdict is **"either unanswered"** → sprint **off track**, as this card's brief already specifies. Do not soften it because "something might arrive": an unanswered deadline that is quietly extended is the exact failure this card exists to prevent.

### The correction: freeze the build, not the commit

`.vitepress/config.mts` has **no `srcExclude`** and sets `ignoreDeadLinks: true`. VitePress builds the **working tree**, not the index. So a "freeze on the diff" that only forbids `git commit` **does not freeze publication**:

- `npm run docs:build` / any deploy publishes `features/ciso.md` (168 lines, unowned, unreviewed) and `transformation/ai-company.md` (3,215 lines of internal strategy whose audience line names *the first pilot companies*) — with no commit and no approval.

**Therefore the 12:00Z outcome must state:** no docs build and no deploy until the diff is decided, and — if a build is unavoidable — `srcExclude` must carry `ciso.md` and `transformation/` first, as a one-line change on `721dc223`.

### Report format for the 12:00Z post (keep it to one screen)

1. **Verdict:** on track / off track — one word, first line.
2. **Answered / not answered** per card, one line each.
3. **Diff size at 12:00Z** vs the baseline above, and whether `browser-use.md` (+91) or `voice-conversation.md` (+185) moved again.
4. **The unpaid human action**, named, with the commercial consequence: unreviewed customer-facing documentation is publishable on the next build, and no QA gate can run because the suite declaration (`e684ce5c`) and the gate root (`b776e9a7`) are both undecided.
5. **Next step with a date** — not "await approval". Recommend the default if silence continues.

### Still binding

Read-only. No repository write, no staging, no revert, and **do not move `a8be6182` or `b776e9a7` to Done** — an agent cannot accept a human decision. Comment on `f6d1855e` (sprint demo, 21 Nov) and close this card once the verdict is written.

## Freeze scope, measured — 2026-11-19 ~11:25Z

The item to freeze at 12:00 is the **index**, and it is smaller than the tree. Measured, in order:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `project_changes(scope="staged", paths=[docs/.vitepress, docs/features])` | **7 files, +374/−0** (tracked +101) ← **freeze this** |
| `project_changes(scope="all", paths=[delivery-contract.md, .vitepress, features, qa, transformation, …])` | **10 files, +424/−0** |
| `qa_review_changes(scope="staged", paths=[the 7])` | **block**, `[high] tests.no-suite`, changed_files 7, **tests executed 0** |
| `repository_overview` | `ahead: 6` (shift 8: `ahead: 2`) |

**Freeze = keep the index at 7 files / +374. Do not `git add` after this point.**

Out of scope of the freeze — never in any approved baseline:
- `features/code-review.md` `M +40` (unstaged)
- `features/ciso.md` (untracked)
- `transformation/ai-company.md` (untracked, 3215 lines of internal strategy per `721dc223`)

Two things the watchdog should state plainly:

1. **Freezing is not verifying.** The frozen snapshot still gates `block` with **0 tests executed** (`tests.no-suite`). The correct wording for the report is "held unverified", never "green".
2. **The freeze cannot undo what already shipped.** 4 commits (`325e7e5`, `14390e3`, `1af62f8`, `dba24f4`; 353 files, +130010/−751) landed between shift 8 and now, on a tree whose QA verdict was `block`. They are past the freeze point; the sprint report must say the QA gate was not consulted for them.
3. Also worth one line: the index disagrees with the worktree on 3 of its own 7 files (+10 unstaged), so a commit taken during the freeze ships a snapshot that predates the last edits.

Sprint status on QA evidence: **off-track**, independent of the approval outcome.

## WATCHDOG FIRED — 2026-11-19T13:3xZ: both human actions unanswered at 12:00Z → docs diff frozen, sprint recorded off-track

### 1. The two inputs (as measured now)
| card | state | wake | human reply |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a8be6182` approve/hold/reject the docs diff | **onhold** ("User action needed") | re-armed 2026-11-20T08:00Z | **none** — the only comments in the thread are agent comments |
| `b776e9a7` confirm gate root A or C | **onhold** ("User action needed") | re-armed 2026-11-20T08:33Z | **none** — an agent self-certified C in `delivery-contract.md`; no human confirmation |

Both still sitting in "User action needed" with a future wake is the definition of "not answered": a task the scheduler re-arms is a task nobody replied to. **Condition met.**

### 2. The frozen index (this is the freeze)
`project_changes(scope="all", base=HEAD)` → **75 files, +41 996 / −787**. Of those, **67 are `.codx/` control-plane noise** (shift transcripts, `audit.jsonl`, `autonomy/state.json`, board/index JSON). Authored content, which is what a reader would call "the change":

| file | state |
| --- | --- |
| `.vitepress/config.mts` | M +3 |
| `features/browser-use.md` | M +91 |
| `features/chats-and-agents.md` | M +4 |
| `features/code-review.md` | M +40 |
| `features/index.md` | M +3 |
| `features/users-and-security.md` | M +10 |
| `features/suggested-replies.md` | A +88 |
| `features/voice-conversation.md` | A +185 |
| **tracked subtotal** | **8 files, +424 / −0** |
| `features/ciso.md` | untracked (188 lines, unowned — see `15e36fe6`) |
| `transformation/ai-company.md`, `transformation/company-ui.md`, `transformation/images/company-*.png` | untracked (see `721dc223`) |

**Frozen numbers: 8 tracked authored files, +424/−0, plus 5 untracked artefacts (≈3 400 lines) that the build will publish.** Nothing is reverted — a freeze here is a *recording* act: this is the state future approvals are measured against, and any further growth is attributed to whoever grows it.

### 3. What the freeze does and does not change
- **Does not** revert, stage, stash or commit anything. No file was written by this shift (verified: `tmp/` absent, authored diff byte-identical to the measurement above).
- **Does** end the "we are one measurement away from closing the gate" framing. The four prior measurements of this diff were 7/+101 → 9/+424 → 10/+424 → **8/+424** (the file count moves because `.codx` churn changes what counts, not because content stabilised).
- The publish surface is **not** governed by `a8be6182` alone: `features/ciso.md` and `features/suggested-replies.md` are already reachable from the sidebar and `.vitepress/config.mts` has **no `srcExclude`** (0 matches across 120 lines) while `ignoreDeadLinks: true` (line 10) guarantees the build cannot object.

### 4. Verdict posted to `f6d1855e`: sprint **off-track**
Two of the three sprint-critical actions are human-owned and unowned inside the team; the third (test suite) has a landed first test (`09e338b9`) but no runner execution because this profile has no shell. I am reporting, not escalating a fourth time: another reminder adds no information.

**This card is closed out at Review** (progress 100, wake cleared) — the watchdog has delivered its verdict and re-arming it would only repeat this comment.

## Watchdog fired — sprint off-track (verdict `block`), measured at 2026-11-19T~14:00Z

Condition of this card: *if the 19 Nov 08:00 approval and the 09:00 decision are **both** unanswered by 12:00Z → freeze the docs diff and report the sprint off-track.*

| item | required | measured now (13:39–14:00Z) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a8be6182` (08:00 approval, "user action needed") | human answer | **not answered** — still `onhold`, no human message, next wake 2026-11-20T08:00Z |
| `b776e9a7` / `e684ce5c` (09:00–09:30 decisions) | human answer | **not answered** — both still `onhold`, both re-armed for 2026-11-20 |
| docs diff | frozen | **not frozen** — 9 files, **+424/−0** (was 7 files/+101 at shift 7; **4th baseline in a row**) |
| suite | declared | **no** — `qa_plan` → `suites: none`, `default_suite: none`, `mapped_tests 0`, no coverage report |

**Verdict: the sprint is off-track.** It is now ~2h past the 12:00Z trigger with zero human input on either card, and the artefact the sprint exists to protect has **grown by 323 lines** meanwhile (`features/code-review.md` +40, `features/ciso.md` 168 untracked, `suggested-replies.md` +88, `voice-conversation.md` +185).

**Freeze statement (read-only, nothing reverted):** the docs deliverable is frozen *as measured* — I will not certify any state of `features/**` or `.vitepress/config.mts` as verified while `suites: none` holds. No file was written, staged or reverted by QA; the tree remains exactly as the approval will find it.

**Open + blocking for the sprint close (`f6d1855e`, 21 Nov):** `tests.no-suite` (HIGH) has now persisted through **8 consecutive shifts**; the gate itself has 3 measured false-green axes (`run_tests=False`, `paths` root split, committed artefacts invisible to a diff gate). Closing the card as **done** — its condition fired and its verdict is delivered; re-arming it would only repeat this comment.
